newsitem.title: USA: Ten killed after pickup collides with dump truck.
newsitem.headline: Ten killed after pickup collides with dump truck.

text.p: Ten people, including eight children, were killed when the pickup truck they were riding was ripped apart in a collision with a dump truck towing a trailer on a rural road Tuesday, police said.
Three other children also riding in the pickup were airlifted to the University of Michigan Hospital in Ann Arbor, Mich. Their conditions were not available from hospital officials late Tuesday.

The accident occurred about 6 p.m. in western Jackson County in the south-central part of the state. Jackson County Sheriff Sgt. Mike Lazaroff said the pickup was carrying eight people in the bed with a covered shell and five in the extended cab.
Police were still investigating the accident Tuesday night. But Lazaroff said it appeared the pickup truck either failed to stop at a stop sign or yield the right of way to the dump truck.
"The impact caused both vehicles to leave the roadway," he said. "The bed of the pickup separated from the frame of the vehicle."
Police had not released names of the victims, which included two adults. All of the victims appeared to be from the Albion, Mich., area.
The dump truck driver was not injured and was released by police after their initial investigation.
"In my 22 years, this is a first for me," said Lazaroff. "I can imagine that this is the worst we've seen in a long time."
